notes: Aether OS: a single-file browser desktop with invented visual language, procedural wallpapers, synthesized sound, a real window manager, persisted virtual filesystem, and 10 apps (Files, Terminal, Editor, Paint, Music, Calendar, Browser, Monitor, Settings, Calculator). Includes lock screen, launcher with live search, notifications, alt-tab, context menus, and keyboard shortcuts. Terminal supports pipes, redirection, history, and tab completion.
